title: Flavius Sabinus, the prefect of the city
aka: Sabinus the prefect of the city
lead: Vespasian's elder brother, prefect of the city of Rome, who took the Capitol in December 69 and was killed after it burned. A different Flavius Sabinus, consul in AD 69, is identified by Townend (Wikipedia) as Vespasian's nephew.

sections.h: His life as Tacitus sums it up
sections.b: Tacitus says he served 35 years, governed Moesia for seven and was prefect of the city for twelve, and that his one fault was talking too much. He was Vespasian's elder brother and had outranked him in money and influence before Vespasian became emperor (3:65, 3:75). Josephus says Sabinus seized the Capitol by night (War 4.645).
